Estimating from the photo, the bowl holds a large pile of diced cooked chicken breast, plus shredded carrot, cherry tomatoes and sliced red onion.

- Chicken: about 200 g at roughly 1.65 kcal/g, so about 330 kcal.
- Carrot: about 40 g, so about 16 kcal.
- Cherry tomatoes: about 70 g, so about 13 kcal.
- Red onion: about 15 g, so about 6 kcal.

That gives about 325 g of food and about 365 kcal.
